title: Here's what's live, and what's next
lede: Everything from our call this morning. The new booking page goes live on Monday.

items.title: On your site: [book.harbourdental.com](https://book.harbourdental.com)
bullets: **Booking in 3 steps.** Pick a service, pick a time, confirm. No account needed.
**Reminders.** A text the day before and two hours before every visit.
**Your calendar stays the source.** Anything booked here lands on the front desk calendar.

items.title: Follow up texts
bullets: **Missed a visit.** A friendly text the next morning with a rebook link.
**Six months since a cleaning.** One text, then one email a week later.

items.title: Reviews
bullets: **One ask, after the visit.** Happy patients go to Google, anyone unhappy comes to you first.
**Copy for your OK:** in the shared folder.
Your OK on the review text
The front desk's cell for missed visit alerts
Which services patients can book online

closing: Questions on any of this, text us. We go through it together on Monday.
